lines.say: A cinema seat says how far along, then how far up.
The Cartesian plane is two number lines crossing at right angles.
The x axis goes across. Right is positive, left is negative.
The y axis goes up and down. Up is positive, down is negative.
They cross at the origin, the point zero, zero.
Every point has coordinates, x first, then y.
Plot negative 4, 2. Start at the origin.
Negative 4 means go 4 left.
Then 2 means go 2 up. There's our point.
Order matters. 2, 5 and 5, 2 are different points.
The axes cut the plane into four quadrants.

draw.alt: Four quadrants of the Cartesian plane

lines.say: Start top right. That's the first quadrant. Both signs positive.

draw.alt: Four quadrants of the Cartesian plane

lines.say: Go anticlockwise. Second is top left, third is bottom left.

draw.alt: Four quadrants of the Cartesian plane

lines.say: Fourth is bottom right. x positive, y negative.
A point like 0, 5 sits on an axis. It's in no quadrant.
Start at negative 3, 2. Move 5 right and 6 down.
Right changes x. Negative 3 plus 5 is 2.
Down changes y. 2 minus 6 is negative 4.
A rectangle runs from x negative 3 to x 4.

Reflect in the x axis. It flips up and down. y changes sign.

Number the quadrants anticlockwise, from the top right.

x across, y up or down. Always x first.
